items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: First I had a band at the Nemo Club with me, Don Byas -- small band, like a John Kirby style band with Don Byas on tenor and I played clarinet. And Otis Johnson on trumpet, Pete Jacobs on drums, Clyde Harte on piano and Bass Hill on bass.

ctx.x: Then I stayed with them at the Grand Terrace. When we finished the Grand Terrace I left Fletcher and came back to New York. Then when I got back to New York I played at the Savoy with Don Redman and then I played -- had my own band

at the Savoy for a while. And then Benny Carter and I got a group. It was Benny Carter's group but I had the book. First I had a band at the Nemo Club with me, Don Byas -- small band, like a John Kirby style band with Don Byas on tenor and I played clarinet. And Otis Johnson on trumpet, Pete Jacobs on drums, Clyde Harte on piano and Bass Hill on bass. We played at the Nemo Club and we played at the -- that was Bill Robinson's place. And we played also at the Elks Rendezvous at the Town. And then we also played at…
